classification_model.compiled: NOT_MEASURED: the research harness invokes the native source SBOM target without compiling F Prime.
classification_model.declared: Pinned Python requirements and GitHub Action uses parsed independently from source declarations.
classification_model.detected: Unique name/version pairs emitted as packages by the native Syft SPDX.
classification_model.distributed: NOT_MEASURED: no flight binary, release bundle, or production installation was built.
classification_model.resolved: Cargo.lock package name/version entries parsed independently.

interpretation_limits: Set differences may reflect ecosystem normalization, conditional markers, local/root packages, or cataloger scope.
Agreement establishes only agreement for the selected declaration classes; it is not proof of completeness.
CMake registration calls are source declarations, not a configured, compiled, linked, or distributed graph.
